messages:
Maya (AE): Heads-up — Customer (FinSys) wants a short POC for Azure AD SAML + SCIM. Key asks: nested group sync, SCIM audit logs, RBAC mapping, and Dedicated vs Private pricing. Can we run next week?
Noah (SE): Quick checklist: domain verification for tenant binding, SAML metadata exchange, SCIM credentials (bearer token), expected user counts, and conditional access requirements.
Rachel (Customer): We enforce MFA + device compliance via Conditional Access. Can you work with our security team on IP allowlist or Private control plane?
Priya (Security): Short answer: Private supports customer VPC and KMS; Dedicated can use IP allowlist for CA. Hosted requires customers to permit our egress IPs or use an intermediate proxy. Need to know which.
Ethan (Eng): On nested groups: our SCIM connector can expand nested groups during ingestion. For very large nesting we recommend flattening during initial import. We also support mapping group attribute -> role name via rules.
Maya (AE): Rachel — any numbers? users/groups/approx active daily?
Rachel (Customer): Plan: 85k total users, ~3.2k groups, ~420 nested groups (depth up to 4). Daily active ~18k. Churn low but org imports are large on quarterly syncs.
Noah (SE): For that scale, POC plan: 1) Bulk CSV import to accelerate initial population; 2) enable delta SCIM sync every 10-15m; 3) monitor rate limits and error retries. We'll provide a runbook.
Priya (Security): They asked about SCIM auditability. For Private/Dedicated we can stream audit logs to customer S3 or syslog. For Hosted we provide webhook exports + 30d retention by default. Also we support token rotation policies for provisioning credentials.
Rachel (Customer): Legal requires SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence, plus SAML metadata exchange and a policy for SCIM token rotation.
Priya (Security): We'll attach SOC2/ISO docs and an example token rotation schedule. Recommend rotating provisioning tokens at least quarterly; Private can automate via KMS/HSM integration.
Maya (AE): Pricing: they want a 3-week POC cost and then a 6mo Dedicated commitment quote. Noah — can you sketch rough numbers?
Noah (SE): Preliminary: POC (shared infra + small Dedicated for parity) estimate ~ $6k for 3 weeks. For 6mo Dedicated (prod parity for 85k users) ballpark $45k/mo — depends on tokens/sec and model footprint. I'll refine with the cost sheet once we confirm throughput.
Ethan (Eng): Blockers to start next week: 1) Customer must verify domain (DNS TXT) to enable tenant pinning; 2) Provide AAD app with SAML metadata + SCIM bearer token; 3) Confirm expected peak token/sec and model selection (low-latency vs throughput).
Rachel (Customer): I'll ask infra to add DNS TXT and create the AAD app. Expect to have SAML metadata and a SCIM client secret by Wed.
Noah (SE): Also note SCIM paging/delta behavior: if they use nested groups heavily, initial bulk may take hours. We'll offer a bulk import option for POC to avoid throttling.
Priya (Security): Draft answer for questionnaire Q14 (user data residency): "For Dedicated & Private deployments user identity data and SCIM logs can be stored within the customer's chosen region and exported to customer-managed storage using their KMS. Hosted deployments offer region options with configurable retention."
Noah (SE): Runbook items I'll send: DNS verification steps, where to paste SAML metadata in the console, sample SCIM mapping rules, and CSV schema for bulk import.
Maya (AE): Can we add a canary auth plan? Rachel, they'd like to route 2% traffic initially.
Ethan (Eng): Canary plan: route 2% of auth traffic to POC endpoints for 48 hours, monitor assertion failures and latency, then ramp to 25% over a week if stable. Rollback path: revert to token-only provisioning or disable provisioning webhook.
deploy-bot: POC environment deploy queued for 2026-04-05T09:30Z.
Rachel (Customer): Sounds good. We'll prioritize the AAD app and token. Thanks team.
Maya (AE): Next steps summary: Noah to send sizing + cost spreadsheet; Priya to attach SOC2/ISO snippets and token rotation policy; Rachel to provide SAML metadata and SCIM creds; Ethan to prepare bulk import runbook. Back here with updates by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
